about_the_game:
Hey! Welcome to the Press a Button Simulator DEMO²: A new, amazing, and some would say award winning demonstration of a game about pressing a button! Spend however long you want in that room, pressing that button. Don’t look for anything else because there is nothing but the button! No secrets, no other gameplay, and that means, no tryhards! 

"Why would you make a Demo for a game about Pressing a Button?"

Why Buttons of course! The ent- Wait... Demo? This is literally a game about pressing a button, I never released a demo for it? Unless..

Eh- Nevermind.

However a button isn't the only thing in the game silly! Press a button Simulator³ includes (at no extra cost to you):

  • A Radio with Rad Tunez!

  • A Closet!

  • A Window!

  • An ultra accurate click counter!

  • Walls!

  • A Ceiling! 

  • And Fun!

The possibilities have an end! With all the walls you will be able to focus on the true meaning of this game: pressing The Button™! Is there a deep meaning? That's for you to figure out, it's art after all.

² Dev Note: Hello team, I just wanted to write to say thank you for all your hard work in getting this DEMO together! I truly hope this can give us the motivation to complete the game! This should bring us a lot of attention! Good work everyone, an I'm sorry I couldn't be there for the demo release. 

³ Dev Note: Hello team, I just wanted to write to say that I'm sorry. I have let you all down. This game was supposed to be a breakthrough, but.. this demo showed us that maybe this idea won't work out. Not to fret! I will reuse the Steam page for both the main game and Demo to show off our newest project! (Whatever that turns out to be).

short_description: Welcome to Press a Button Simulator: a new and exciting twist on modern video games. Gone is the time of tryhards and sweats, and in is the new age of only pressing a button! Will you find all the secrets? Of course not! There is only one: You get to press a button!
